description: Fits the image onto an exact canvas, padding with white: amazon (2000×2000), ebay (1600×1600), etsy (2000×2000), square (1080×1080), instagram_portrait (1080×1350), story (1080×1920), or custom width/height. Without an API key: returns a free watermarked preview (≤700px) plus unlock_url, which a human opens to download the full-resolution file for site credits (then call get_result). With an API key (Authorization: Bearer stb_…): returns download_url for the full-resolution file directly and charges the key owner's credits when the job starts, refunded automatically if processing fails. Retrying a call creates and charges a new job — use get_result to fetch an earlier one.

image_base64.description: The image as base64 (or a data: URL), max 2 MB. Use only when no public URL is available.

image_url.description: Public https:// URL of the image. Preferred over image_base64.
